title: New era of the VOOL App
seoTitle: Enter the new era of VOOL App
description: Learn about the major updates in the VOOL EV charging app. VOOL App is the perfect companion for VOOL EV Charger, and any other OCPP-compliant charger.
body:
We keep developing the VOOL App as the perfect companion for your VOOL or any other OCPP-compliant EV charger. This mind, we have rolled out a major update to make your EV charging experience smoother and more reliable.

What’s new with the VOOL App?

Charger-first approach

The VOOL App's focus shifts from EV-only charging to charger-based charging. This means that now you need to add your charger to the app. Any OCPP-compliant charger will do. However, we guarantee the best experience with the VOOL Charger.

If you still don't have a VOOL EV Charger, but would like a good deal, get in touch with us. We have special discount if you mention "VOOL App Friends" until 21 April 2024.

However, if you already have an OCPP-compliant charger that you are happy with, learn how to add your non-VOOL charger in the VOOL system.

More reliable

We have learned that EV-only charging, which we have partially used so far, is not a reliable way to charge your vehicle. Car APIs are not always responsive, and some car manufacturers don’t provide enough capabilities to perform reliable day-to-day charging. Charger-first mode provides more stability for your EV charging.

Fresh design

We constantly keep developing the charger-first look of the VOOL App to give you the smoothest user experience in the EV charging world.
